function checked<T>(value: T) {
  if (typeof value === "object" && value !== null) return value.toString();
}
function reversed<T>(value: T) {
  if (value != null && typeof value === "object") return value["toString"]();
}
function optional<T>(value: T) {
  if (typeof value === "object") return value?.toString();
}
function preserved<T extends { id: number } | null>(value: T) {
  if (typeof value === "object" && value !== null) return value.id;
}
function exact<T extends { id: number }>(value: T) {
  if (typeof value === "object") return value.id;
}
console.log(checked(null), checked({}), reversed({}), optional(null), optional({}));
console.log(preserved(null), preserved({ id: 1 }), exact({ id: 2 }));
